show.description: Dahaad is a story of a rising wrestler, whose dream shatters when betrayal, false doping charges, and sacrifice tear lovers apart. Eight years later, truth resurfaces through their daughter, forcing fate to reunite them. Dahaad is a powerful saga of love, sacrifice, redemption, and justice.Watch now.
